change: DEV3 Catalog capture LOAD (dev3-visibility-retirement.md#catalog-capture-load): read_catalog reads the fixed Catalog anchor (page 7) and leaf (page 8) resident only, and the pool's victim selection replaces either page once it is clean, after which every Full Catalog lookup and table issue was refused Frame(MissingTarget) Unchanged (on main e0723ae; small pools such as SPL-A05's 18 frames). The Full class now LOADs a missing page before capture_catalog (CatalogReadOperation::load_catalog: registry probe, then the reader's lookup LOAD with the other page protected; a dirty victim is FlushRequired with no effect); the resident class still never LOADs (its retryable Busy). The LOAD phase is priced as its own phase before the capture (34,452 B, below the other phases' peak 34,540 B); the Full charge 34,588 B, ceilings and the Full-beside-Pending window are unchanged. Begin stays resident-only (unassigned obligation). No schedule credit (bug fix).

rust_tests.reason: The fix (dev3-visibility-retirement.md#catalog-capture-load): Catalog's select (catalog/read.rs) calls C's new CatalogReadOperation::load_catalog (read/operation.rs) before capture_catalog, so every Full lookup and table issue (CatalogCallScope/CatalogStatementCall lookup, finish_table, the legacy ReadPort::lookup_catalog) first probes the registry for the Catalog anchor 7 and leaf 8 and LOADs a missing one through load_lookup_target with the other page protected; a dirty victim is Selection::Flush -> FlushRequired with no effect; the resident class returns Ready at once. read/catalog.rs moves the two fixed requests of read_catalog into catalog_requests (same identity/kind/level), shared by read_catalog (also B's Row read capture_schema) and load_catalog. CEV-J01..J06 drive the new path: J01 issues T after none/anchor/leaf/both left the pool and asserts the replay scopes/checkouts (each LOAD +1/+1, a resident lookup the pre-fix (2, 1): fails with the probe removed), J02 the table issue's dirty-victim FlushRequired round trip with no effect, J03 the resident class Busy then a Full issue, J04 the leaf LOAD keeping the just-loaded anchor and lookup's FlushRequired (fails with the protected set emptied), J05 the first lookup after eviction for Found and Missing, J06 a LOADed leaf holding an Active CREATE answers Missing; with the load_catalog call removed J01 (evicted), J02-J06 and SPL-A05 fail Frame(MissingTarget) Unchanged. SPL-A05 meets the defect naturally (18 frames: the split's pages took the anchor's frame; the new statement's table issue LOADs it). The existing Catalog read cases are re-run so a lookup whose pages are resident keeps its behaviour. Of the 61 catalog_memory cases in this mapping, 53 enter load_catalog (Full or resident class): table_issue (S1F), statement_reads, read_boundary, call_scope, resident_read/resident_faults (the resident class), visibility_gap, issued_gap, commit_concurrency (lookups beside Catalog commits), row_read_live (B's Row read), CEV-J01..J06 and SPL-A05; table_issue::capture_without_visibility_proof_cannot_issue_a_table reaches only catalog_requests (through read_catalog), as do the two read::catalog original_owner unit cases. The other 7 catalog_memory cases (admitted_validation's two, call_scope::direct_error_finish_keeps_priority_and_original_accounting, commit_concurrency's catalog_commit_reservation_capacity_reopens_reads, catalog_mt05_pending_lower_flush and catalog_mt06_flush_capture_then_commit, statement_reads::missing_original_visibility_is_rejected_before_admission) and the other read::catalog/read::statement unit cases stop before select (admission, capacity and commit order of the same Full charge) and are kept as its neighbours: the charge they reserve is the one priced in the second mapping. Catalog's own carrier bound (product_carriers_fit_the_lower_fixed_budget) checks catalog/read.rs's source_bytes, which now charges one carrier for the load step's and the Status step's results. The native worker s5r_n01 is excluded (#[ignore], controller-only). (Reach per case: the r3 review's probe, module-gate/evidence/catalog-capture-load/review-r3.md.)

The census of the new phase: lookup_source_bytes = lookup_phase_source_bytes (the old formula without the new term) max catalog_load_source_bytes + the statement's held part; the Catalog LOAD phase is held_before_capture 1,044 + CATALOG_PRODUCT_SOURCE 2,042 + catalog_load_frame 280 + lookup_load 31,086 = 34,452 B, below the other phases' peak 34,540 B (Status/Undo LOAD), so the Full charge stays 34,588 B. CEV-C01 asserts load <= peak (fails with the frame +89 B). operation.rs splits held_source_bytes into held_before_capture + captured_copy (sum unchanged). The 42 other census cases (owner_tests catalog charges, read::scope, source::tests incl. catalog_commit_windows_fit_beside_admitted_readers and the Full-beside-Pending window 65,486 <= 65,536, s2w_c04, product carriers) are re-run and print the same values as the base 0197f199.

The test files of this change: catalog_memory.rs declares the new catalog_eviction module (C test; its own files helper, no A import), catalog_eviction.rs holds CEV-J01..J06, and auto_split.rs's SPL-A05 asserts the anchor left the pool before the new statement's read ([false, true]) and both pages are resident after it.
